findings.text: root_path is interpolated into a regex without re.escape. A root_path containing regex metacharacters, such as '/api(v1' or '/a+b', raises re.error or matches the wrong text. A root_path of '/app.v1' also strips '/appxv1'. Also, the pattern is not checked against a path-segment boundary, so root_path '/app' turns path '/application' into 'lication'. It also strips when the path doesn't actually start with root_path. Use a startswith check with a slice instead.
Adds a top-level import of starlette.types in _utils. If starlette.types imports from _utils, or something that does, this creates a circular import risk at module load time.
